title: ‘Dancing with the Stars’: Here’s Where to Watch Season 35 Live Online for Free
summary: New episodes of DWTS air live starting on Tuesday, Sept. 15 — contestants include Tatyana Ali, Giada De Laurentiis, Ciara Miller, Harry Shum Jr., Julia Stiles and others.
contentText:

Hosted by Alfonso Ribeiro and Julianne Hough, Dancing with the Stars returns for season 35 with new contests paired with professional dancers , such as Tatyana Ali with Jan Ravnik, Giada De Laurentiis with Alan Bersten, Ciara Miller with Brandon Armstrong, Harry Shum Jr. with Jenna Johnson, Julia Stiles with Ezra Sosa and others.

Additionally, Derek Hough, Carrie Ann Inaba and Bruno Tonioli return as judges.

How to Watch ‘Dancing with the Stars’ Season 35 Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Starting on Tuesday, Sept. 15

- Network: ABC

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Disney+

Watch on DirecTV

What Time Is Does ‘Dancing with the Stars’ Season 35 Start ?

Dancing with the Stars season 35 begins on Tuesday (Sept. 15) with the men’s performances and Wednesday (Sept. 16) with the women’s performances. Both nights start at 8 p.m. ET/PT. The reality competition broadcasts on Tuesdays and Wednesdays until the season finale on ABC .

Where to Watch ‘Dancing with the Stars’ Season 35 Online for Free

If you’re a Dancing with the Stars fan and cord-cutter, then there are a number of ways to watch without cable — especially if you want to watch for free. For example: DirecTV offers a five-day free trial to try out the streaming service, while others like Fubo and Hulu + Live TV offer free trials too, so you can watch ABC without spending money up front.

EDITOR'S PICK

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Comes with a five-day free trial.

You can watch local networks, such as NBC, CBS and FOX, while you can also watch many cable networks, including FX, AMC, A&E, Bravo, Cartoon Network, ESPN, FS1, VH1, Fuse, CNN, Food Network, Lifetime, CNBC, BET, MTV, Paramount Network and many others.

Sling TV

Get Sling TV

Sling Blue comes with 40+ channels.

Sling TV offers Blue, which comes with ABC. With more than 40 channels, the streaming plan goes for $54.99 per month and comes with a free cloud DVR and additional free channels. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary from market-to-market.

FuboTV

The service gets you live access to local broadcast networks including NBC, CBS and FOX, while it also has dozens of cable networks, such as FX, Bravo, TLC, ESPN, E!, FS1, MTV, CMT, ID, Ion, OWN, Paramount Network, TV Land, VH1 and much more.

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited.

The broadcast network ABC is available to watch with Hulu + Live TV too. Prices for the cable alternative start at $89.99 per month, while each plan comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost. Hulu + Live TV might be best for those who want all of these streaming services together in one package. It also features many other networks, like CBS, NBC, FOX, BET, CMT, Disney Channel, ESPN, Hallmark Channel and more.

Disney+

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $11.99 per month for the ad-supported plan , while you can go ad-free for $18.99 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $12.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $21.99 per month.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $19.99 per month.

More Ways to Watch

Dancing with the Stars season 35 broadcasts Tuesdays and Wednesdays starting on Tuesday (Sept. 15) at 8 p.m. ET/PT on ABC. One of the best ways to watch is with DirecTV .
